title: Squarespace Conversion
meta: Clearer pages, shorter forms and stronger calls to action so more Squarespace visitors enquire or buy. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Squarespace conversion, more enquiries and sales
overview: We look at where visitors drop off on your Squarespace site and improve those pages. That can be a sharper headline, a more visible button, a shorter enquiry form, trust signals near the price, better product pages and a mobile layout that is easier to tap. We set up analytics goals so you can measure what changes. We aim for a clearer next step and do not promise a set lift.

pkgs.blurb: Fixes to one key page, applied in your site.
Your top pages improved, with tracking in place.
A full path from visitor to buyer, with popup and email.

faq: No, and be careful of anyone who does. We remove common friction and give you tracking so that you can see the effect. What happens next depends on your traffic, prices and offer.
Do you change my prices or offers?
No. We suggest changes in presentation, like where the price sits and how benefits are written. Pricing and offer choices stay with you, and we note where a different offer might help.
Squarespace has built-in popups, forms and analytics, and we use them first. If a heatmap tool is useful, free options such as Microsoft Clarity work with a small code snippet we install.
Will you rewrite my product descriptions?
We improve the key lines on the pages in scope and keep your voice. Writing every product description is a larger project that we can quote on request.
